baseline: 0f + firstdot V2 + original C8; P4 default-off

reject_before_cast: finite positive scale with quotient outside -128.5 < z < 127.5

lifecycle.aliasing: readonly inputs and all writable ranges mutually disjoint; three projections share only x/xs; no concurrent reuse of writable storage

gates: G0 complete pinned source closure and fixture identity
G1 GNU build and final ELF link/array/route/object audit
G2 independent exact FP32 quantization oracle and complete QKV numerical checking
G3 full128 slots/read-write ranges/guards/CSR/integer and FP ABI
G4 actual corrupted input/object/ELF/metadata negative controls
G5 reproducible software relocation and integrity preservation

numeric_coverage.quantize_inputs: both actual positions plus semantic 9-group fixture; every q byte and scale bit pattern
numeric_coverage.projection: both positions by both methods by Q,K,V, full outputs; actual-machine-code model where supported
numeric_coverage.slots: full128 every modeled store; high96 zero
numeric_coverage.flags: static semantic/encoding proof and host model separately; actual target flags NOT_TESTED

allowed: GNU cross-build and static link to existing AM
host Python/C checks and object models

future_probe_rules.gain_meaning: at least 3% conservative cycle reduction; speedup=min(FR)/max(TA)
future_probe_rules.warmup: one same-method full boundary before each measured window, symmetric prepare
future_probe_rules.controls: each method own exact machine-derived instruction/custom counts; common measurement/control operations equal; do not demand FR instret = TA instret
future_probe_rules.stop: first failure or unmet gain/anchor, no auto-expand
future_probe_rules.permission: future separate round only; budget, exact images and derived counts must be frozen before target
